summary: Solid PowerShell solution with clean modularity and good conventions. Strengths: proper $ErrorActionPreference, [Parameter(Mandatory)] validation, -LiteralPath defensiveness, clear module exports, pinned action refs, minimal YAML permissions. Weaknesses: Test-WorkflowWithAct.ps1 lines 67-68 suppress git stderr (2>&1|Out-Null) risking hidden errors; lines 52-57 repeat Copy-Item calls (scripts/tests/.github/.actrc/version.json/commits.txt) that could be factored into a loop; git command flags repeated at 67-68. No explicit check for act availability. Otherwise excellent design with clear separation of concerns.
